title: Spore germination and development of the young gametophyte of the ostrich fern (Matteuccia struthiopteris)
why: The Smithsonian page gives no abstract; the paper should say whether light (and which colour) controls spore germination in the ostrich fern, a light response measured in the species itself.

title: Pollinating birds differ in spectral sensitivity
why: The abstract says SWS1 opsin key sites separate hummingbirds and honeyeaters from the Passerida and covers sunbirds, but the page does not say where sunbirds fall; the full text and its species table should place Cinnyris and Anthochaera (or their families) as violet-sensitive or ultraviolet-sensitive.

title: Topography of retinal ganglion cells of a northern goshawk (Accipiter gentilis)
why: Title seen only (the BioOne page returned a bot-protection stub). A ganglion-cell map of Accipiter gentilis would give peak cell density and anatomical acuity for the genus Accipiter, which carries to the sparrowhawks and other Accipiter on the list.

title: not confirmed (retinal ganglion cell layer of tyrant flycatchers including the rusty-margined flycatcher Myiozetetes cayanensis; cited as Coimbra et al. 2006 and 2009 in Baumhardt et al. 2014 and Salazar et al. 2020)
why: Seen only as citations. These tyrannid retina maps give neuron density and topography for Myiozetetes cayanensis (about 65,000 cells/mm2 in the ganglion cell layer, per Baumhardt 2014), from which spacing and acuity follow for the genus.

title: Spectral sensitivity and visual conditioning in the parasitoid wasp Trybliographa rapae (Hymenoptera: Cynipidae)
